scope_note: Parent introduces only the closed-epiphysis branch and is not a standalone clinical predicate. ChildGH tests and organic/laboratory diagnosis are not automatically evaluated. Adult open-epiphysis patients reference pediatric rules under a separate source paragraph; adult patient group alone does not establish closed epiphyses. Existing report-only route is not full adult eligibility. Unsupported generic hormone and somatrogon aliases removed from current somatropin-only adult rules. No new clinical denial or historical enactment interval introduced.
